title: Consumer Protection Act, Cap. 326D (misleading or deceptive conduct, false representations)
evidence: Margin note under the long title of the consolidated text: "[16th January, 2003] Commencement. 2003/1." (Supreme Court Registry PDF, opened 2026-11-05, 200, application/pdf, sha256 31b5d8540f2633902ce6c289cb3ab132f24bf49cd40dd4913dc9bbd6ff2d77ce).
notes: Link only: the row is permission requested (All Rights Reserved footer, no terms page, no statute exception in Cap. 300), so no text is stored. s. 12(1): "A person shall not, in trade or commerce as a supplier, engage in conduct that is, or is likely to be, misleading or deceptive." The Act has no environmental-claims section; it is the general umbrella for green claims. Section numbers 13, 15 and 16 (false representations, misleading conduct in relation to goods and services) are from the table of contents of the same PDF; the enforcement sections (ss. 54-55) were not re-read. Fair Competition Act, Cap. 326C was checked and left out: its text has no misleading-conduct section.

title: Control of Disposable Plastics Act, 2019 (Act 2019-11)
citation: Control of Disposable Plastics Act, 2019-11, Supplement to Extraordinary Gazette dated 29th March, 2019
evidence: Act PDF: "[Commencement: 1st April, 2019]" and s. 13 "This Act shall come into force on the 1st day of April, 2019"; assent line "S. MASON, Governor-General, 29th March, 2019" (https://barbadosparliament-laws.com/uploads/Barbados-act/Act%202019%20-%2011.pdf, opened 2026-11-05, 200, application/pdf, sha256 f31247a8000e6b64704eaf3c3815cd0f205305c3a799fdc490db048710bd6880).
notes: Link only: the row is permission requested (All Rights Reserved footer, no terms page, no statute exception in Cap. 300), so no text is stored. Bans importation, manufacture and retail of certain disposable plastics. s. 9 is an environmental-claims offence: a false or misleading claim that single-use plastic containers or cutlery are "environmentally sustainable" (fine $50 000 or one year). Filed under F2 for the ban; s. 9 is F6 content. The Parliament's Annual Acts list shows two later acts of the same name, 2019-60 (Control of Disposable Plastics (Amendment), commencement 30th December 2019) and 2020-8 (commencement 30th April 2020); their texts were not read and they have no scope entry.
